about: The hub's frozen sync wire fixture, version 2 (D-H0BZN in rdy-design, p-1FPMG in rdyhub-design). Version 1 stays beside it.
Each step holds one request to the real hub and the hub's reply, as the test sk13_ in rdyhub-server/tests/pg_sk13_wire_v2.rs checks them, in the order the test sends them.
Normalized: the bearer token is <token>, and each request id is <request-id>. Object members are in key order.

The hub repo is acme/docs with the site docs-site, owned by ana, on a test install with Share on and its default sync settings. A publication upload of tag v1.0.0 of rdyhub-core's Signed upload fixture gave the hub repo its upload history first.
Each push is a canon history of rdyhub-core's push fixture, put in one batch: its chain is the landing of v1.0.0, then three landings after it. A binary body gives its length and sha256.
The extend's gate settings name a pack digest that the test chose: the hub computes no pack digest and compares the digests as each write sent them (D-BYZR0).
The case E_HUB_SHARE_OFF comes from a second service of the same build with Share off.
The list headers names the request headers that the hub reads on these steps. The hub refuses no header that the list leaves out.
The list not_served names the cases of D-H0BZN that this hub does not serve yet, with the design that sets each one and the reason.

headers.use: a GET of a hub repo's address that accepts application/vnd.rdy.sync+json gets discovery

headers.use: the body's bound is checked before the body is read; put needs it
